name: Brigindo

attributes.attribute: thought to be identified with Brigantia and Brigit

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Brigindo is a Continental goddess of the east of Gaul. Inscriptions are the only record of her. Scholars think she may be the same goddess as Brigantia and Brigit. Romans of the region set stones in her honour, and her name survives only on those stones. She belongs to the Continental Celtic world rather than the Irish realm.

key_results: Brigindo is a goddess of eastern Gaul.
She is known only from inscriptions.
Scholars link her to Brigantia and Brigit.
